items.prompt:
Combining facts from several texts on one topic gives you:
A) a fuller, more accurate understanding
B) fewer facts
C) nothing
items.answer: A) a fuller, more accurate understanding

steps: More info together. Key is A.
solution.answer: A) a fuller, more accurate understanding

items.prompt:
When two sources AGREE on a fact, you can:
A) trust it more
B) ignore it
C) assume it is false

steps: Agreement builds confidence. Key is A.

items.prompt:
To 'integrate' information means to:
A) combine it
B) delete it
C) hide it

Text A: sharks are fish. Text B: sharks have cartilage skeletons. Text C: sharks smell blood from afar. Using all three, sharks are:
A) fish with cartilage skeletons and a strong sense of smell
B) mammals
C) plants
items.answer: A) fish with cartilage skeletons and a strong sense of smell

steps: Combine all facts. Key is A.
solution.answer: A) fish with cartilage skeletons and a strong sense of smell

items.prompt:
Why read several texts for a report instead of one?
A) to get more facts and check that they agree
B) to waste time
C) to copy one source
items.answer: A) to get more facts and check that they agree

steps: Completeness and accuracy. Key is A.
solution.answer: A) to get more facts and check that they agree

items.prompt:
If three texts about a topic all state the same key fact, that fact is:
A) more reliable
B) probably false
C) irrelevant

steps: Multiple sources confirm. Key is A.

items.prompt:
Text A explains HOW honeybees make honey; Text B explains how they COMMUNICATE with a waggle dance. Integrating both lets you write that honeybees:
A) make honey and communicate the location of flowers by dancing
B) only make honey
C) are birds
items.answer: A) make honey and communicate the location of flowers by dancing

steps: Combine both texts. Key is A.
solution.answer: A) make honey and communicate the location of flowers by dancing

items.prompt:
Two of your sources agree, but a third gives a different 'fact.' The BEST next step is to:
A) find more sources to see which is correct
B) trust the single different source
C) stop researching
items.answer: A) find more sources to see which is correct

steps: Check with more sources. Key is A.
solution.answer: A) find more sources to see which is correct
